name: DealTraq
description: DealTraq connects Claude to your deal pipeline for end-to-end diligence and portfolio research. Pull structured company snapshots, browse pipeline stages, and dig into diligence materials — including deck pages, meeting transcripts, and file contents — directly within a conversation. Run semantic or keyword searches across your portfolio, query pipeline metrics, and get a full research context on any company in one call. When you're ready to act, propose profile or stage changes for review, or execute registered company actions directly, keeping your pipeline data current without leaving Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DealTraq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DealTraq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.dealtraq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DealTraq MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DealTraq lists 16 MCP tools, including execute_company_action, get_company, get_company_research_context, get_dealtraq_identity, get_pipeline_structure, list_companies_in_pipeline_stage, list_company_action_capabilities, list_company_artifacts, propose_company_changes, query_pipeline_metrics, read_company_file, and read_company_file_page.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DealTraq?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DealTraq in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
DealTraq requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DealTraq is developed by DealTraq, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
